messages:
elena: Quick handoff to runtime — need a tiny, citable bench bundle for webinar + launch blog. Minimum: CSV (per-request), one heatmap PNG, env.txt, and a 1-line caveat.
matt: Which model + matrix?
elena: redwood/3b-compat-v1 (prod). Batch: 1 & 8. Concurrency: 1 & 16. Seqlens: 32 / 192 / 1024. Percentiles: 50/95/99 per-request.
sophie: Include token counts and billing units so we can compute $/1k. If quantized int8 is flaky at long context, call that out.
andy: Plan: 2 warmups, 100 samples per cell. Capture 50/95/99, tokens/sec, GPU util, and stderr on kernel warnings. Package: CSV, heatmap.png, env.txt, README with reproduce snippet.
elena: Sample prompts here: https://gist.example.com/redwood/webinar-samples (use "webinar-clean").
matt: We'll record commit hash, CUDA/driver, and kernel mapping. Also produce normalized charts vs hosted fp16 baseline.
andy: Reproduce snippet to include in README:
```
# smoke reproduce
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.internal.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RUNTIME_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/3b-compat-v1","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":64,"batch":1}'
```
bench-bot: Run queued: id=lb-6112-01, logs: /internal/bench/runs/lb-6112-01. ETA ~3h.
matt: If int8 @1024 is unstable we'll flag that cell and attach stderr + suggested conservative phrasing.
sophie: Deadline for artifacts: Thu 18:00 PT. If that's a problem, speak up now.
andy: Aiming for Wed EOD run, Thu morning artifacts. Will post artifact link here when done.
elena: Thanks — please ping @matt and @andy on updates. Keep visuals simple and reproducible.
